title: Order of withdrawals, and big expenses separate
objectives: State the withdrawal order: other income, Bucket 1 SWP, planned refills.
Explain why big known costs get their own pot.
body_md:
Order of withdrawals (rule of thumb). Pension, rent, interest and other regular income first. Then the Bucket 1 SWP. Refill from debt or equity on a plan, never in a panic. Keep the emergency fund separate and untouched for routine spending. Keep big expenses separate: known future costs (a child's wedding, a car, home repairs) get their own pot, invested for their own date (Module 9). They should not come out of the monthly SWP plan.

> **Investor takeaway:** Spend from safety, grow from equity, and refill on a plan.
example: A child's wedding in 3 years: its own pot, invested for its own date — not paid from the monthly SWP.
say: Pension, rent and interest first, then the Bucket 1 SWP.
Keep the emergency fund separate and untouched for routine spending.
never: Use the emergency fund for routine monthly expenses.
Pay big known costs from the monthly SWP.

check.q: A big known cost (child’s wedding) should be…
check.why: Planned as a separate pot. Invested for its own date.

check.q: Should the emergency fund be used for routine monthly expenses?
What comes first in the withdrawal order?
o: Pension, rent, interest and other regular income
check.why: Pension, rent, interest and other regular income first. Then the Bucket 1 SWP.
